trajectory_summary: The call moves steadily from a warm, self-motivated callback into a mechanically sound but emotionally flat verify-and-schedule sequence. The rep captures strong qualifying data (bill, usage trend, EV load, co-owner) but never flips any of it into urgency, leaving a booked appointment that is procedurally solid but under-leveraged.
outcome_dispute: The call should be read as tentative rather than a clean booked appointment: a specific day/time (tomorrow, 10AM) was set, but it is explicitly conditioned on Stacy successfully emailing her bill first, and the co-owner mother was never looped in for the actual specialist visit.
